errors: First manuscript build overflowed its table by 92.6 pt (a source-file column); fixed by moving the source into a table caption that build_tex.py now reads.

doc_friction.issue: --for-changes on a research + docs/posts diff runs the site builder tests, which outlast the 120 s foreground limit and detach; the research checks themselves finish in seconds.

The pdflatex install note lists texlive-latex-recommended and -fonts-recommended, but paper/build_tex.py --pdf also needs texlive-latex-extra and librsvg2-bin (its own docstring says so); installing all four in the background took about 3 minutes, not 10.

deviations.why: Took 6r's Next (e), the paper, rather than a new experiment: the other two Next items need a paywalled multi-unit dataset or an unsourced pump make, and a quick search this run found no open alternative (Kosiba et al. and the GHD 17R preprint report volumetric efficiency only).
deviations.did: A venue-length manuscript with its own number audit, no new experiment.
deviations.result: Landed; 3 of 4 pre-registered targets held, the page target was refuted on the short side (7 pages).

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
